name: The Cathedral Beast
source:
In The Cathedral Beast you play as a nun who has always wondered what was up in the bell tower of the cathedral, today you decide to find out.

This short visual novel takes you to the start of a budding romance between you and the Cathedral Beast.

[From [url=https://marshi0mallow.itch.io/the-cathedral-beast]Itch.io[/url]]
translation: 在《The Cathedral Beast》中，你将扮演一名修女。她一直很好奇大教堂钟楼上究竟有什么，今天终于决定一探究竟。这部短篇视觉小说将带你见证她与大教堂野兽之间刚刚萌芽的爱情。[引自[url=https://marshi0mallow.itch.io/the-cathedral-beast]Itch.io[/url]]
